summary.text: Hidden Dragon Cave is the sealed site that holds the legendary immemorial desolate beast Di Zang Sheng, guarded under Heavenly Court punishment and oversight.

claims.text: Fairy Zi Wei punishes Feng Chan Zi to guard Hidden Dragon Cave and Di Zang Sheng for twenty years, warning that if that Evil Dragon manages to move even a bit he fails his duties and dies. With Feng Chan Zi’s rank six cultivation unable to handle the post, and nobody in Heavenly Court willing to take the mess, she expects Old Man Bei Feng to handle it if he wants a Heavenly Court welcome.
Duke Long tells Fairy Zi Wei to send him to Hidden Dragon Cave while she continues deductions.

At Hidden Dragon Cave, Old Man Bei Feng and Feng Chan Zi greet Duke Long and bring him to the deepest part: a deep earth trench larger than Northern Plains’ Zombie Alliance Earth Trench, able to stuff thousands of cities. Duke Long addresses Di Zang Sheng inside the suppressing super Gu formation he personally created. Narration names Evil Dragon Di Zang Sheng as a legendary immemorial desolate beast formed from hatred, anger, and grudges in Central Continent’s earth veins, born of nature with human-matching intelligence. Heavenly Court uses the formation to suppress it, and Feng Chan Zi’s punishment plus Old Man Bei Feng’s choice to forgo Heavenly Court membership keep them as its current guards. Duke Long extracts life essence from Di Zang Sheng through the formation, then leaves Hidden Dragon Cave.

Eastern Sea rank eights break an illusion formation and find a huge rock cavern with natural dragon markings like dancing dragons. Below it a long-standing natural Earth Trench opens. Old Man Bei Feng appears, names the place Hidden Dragon Cave, and activates the super immortal formation that traps Di Zang Sheng, isolating the attackers. Narration states Hidden Dragon Cave contained Di Zang Sheng and that its location had never been exposed, and that Duke Long placed Dragon Palace here for specific reasons after taking that Immortal Gu House.

Dream realms erode the Hidden Dragon Cave battlefield while Di Zang Sheng struggles against weakening bindings. After Eastern Sea rank eights break free and Dragon Palace smashes the formation core, Wu Shuai captures Old Man Bei Feng and Feng Chan Zi, plunges into the Earth Trench, and frees Evil Dragon Di Zang Sheng. The dragon rises mountain-range huge and flies west toward Central Continent rather than attacking the Eastern Sea immortals.
